1.text: Yesu amaze kuvuga ayo magambo asohokana n'abigishwa be, yambuka umugezi witwa Kidironi, hariho agashyamba akajyanamo n'abigishwa be.

2.text: Kandi na Yuda umugambanira na we yari azi aho hantu, kuko Yesu yahajyanaga n'abigishwa be kenshi.

3.text: Nuko Yuda amaze guhabwa ingabo z'abasirikare n'abagaragu b'abatambyi bakuru n'ab'Abafarisayo, ajyayo afite amatabaza n'imuri n'intwaro.

4.text: Yesu amenye ibyenda kumubaho byose, arabasanganira arababaza ati “Murashaka nde?”

5.text: Baramusubiza bati “Ni Yesu w'i Nazareti.”Arababwira ati “Ni jye.” Na Yuda umugambanira yari ahagararanye na bo.

6.text: Amaze kubabwira ati “Ni jye”, bagenza imigongo bagwa hasi.

7.text: Nuko yongera kubabaza ati “Murashaka nde?”Bati “Ni Yesu w'i Nazareti.”

8.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Mbabwiye ko ari jye. Nuko rero niba ari jye mushaka mureke aba bagende.”

9.text: Yabivugiye atyo kugira ngo rya jambo yavuze risohore, ngo “Mu bo wampaye sinabuzeho n'umwe.”

10.text: Nuko Simoni Petero yari afite inkota, arayikura ayikubita umugaragu w'umutambyi mukuru amuca ugutwi kw'iburyo. Uwo mugaragu yitwaga Maluko.

11.text: Nuko Yesu abwira Petero ati “Subiza inkota mu rwubati rwayo, mbese igikombe Data ampaye ne kukinyweraho?”

12.text: Nuko izo ngabo n'umutware wazo n'abagaragu b'Abayuda bafata Yesu baramuboha,

13.text: babanza kumujyana kwa Ana kuko yari sebukwe wa Kayafa, wari umutambyi mukuru muri uwo mwaka.

14.text: Kandi Kayafa ni we wagiriye Abayuda inama ati “Birakwiriye ko umuntu umwe apfira abantu.”

15.text: Simoni Petero n'undi mwigishwa bakurikira Yesu. Uwo mwigishwa yari azwi n'umutambyi mukuru, yinjirana na Yesu mu rugo rw'umutambyi mukuru.

16.text: Ariko Petero yari ahagaze hanze ku irembo. Wa mwigishwa wundi wari uzwi n'umutambyi mukuru, arasohoka avugana n'umuja ukumīra, nuko yinjiza Petero.

17.text: Uwo muja ukumīra abaza Petero ati “Mbese aho nawe nturi uwo mu bigishwa b'uriya muntu?”Aramusubiza ati “Oya, sindi umwigishwa we.”

18.text: Abagaragu n'abasirikare bari bahagaze aho, bacanye umuriro w'amakara kuko hari imbeho barota, na Petero na we yari kumwe na bo ahagaze yota.

19.text: Nuko umutambyi mukuru abaza Yesu iby'abigishwa be n'ibyo yigishaga.

20.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Nigishaga ab'isi neruye, iteka nigishiriza mu masinagogi no mu rusengero aho Abayuda bose bateranira, nta cyo navuze rwihishwa.

21.text: Urambariza iki? Abumvaga ba ari bo ubaza ibyo nababwiye, ni bo bazi ibyo navuze.”

22.text: Amaze kuvuga atyo, umwe mu basirikare wari uhagaze aho akubita Yesu urushyi ati “Uku ni ko usubiza umutambyi mukuru?”

23.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Niba mvuze ikibi kimpamye. Ariko niba ari neza umpoye iki?”

24.text: Nuko Ana amwohereza ari imbohe kuri Kayafa, umutambyi mukuru.

25.text: Ubwo Simoni Petero yari ahagaze yota. Baramubaza bati “Mbese nawe nturi uwo mu bigishwa be?”Arabihakana ati “Oya, sindi uwo muri bo.”

26.text: Umwe mu bagaragu b'umutambyi mukuru, mwene wabo w'uwo Petero yaciye ugutwi aramubaza ati “Harya sinakubonye uri kumwe na we muri ka gashyamba?”

27.text: Petero yongera kubihakana, muri ako kanya inkoko irabika.

28.text: Bavana Yesu kwa Kayafa bamujyana mu rukiko, hari mu museke. Ubwabo ntibinjira mu rukiko ngo batihumanya, bakabura uko barya ibya Pasika.

29.text: Nuko Pilato arasohoka ajya aho bari ati “Uyu muntu muramurega iki?”

30.text: Baramusubiza bati “Uyu iyaba atakoze icyaha ntituba tumukuzaniye.”

31.text: Pilato arababwira ati “Nimumujyane, abe ari mwe mumucira urubanza nk'uko amategeko yanyu ari.”Abayuda baramubwira bati “Twebwe ntitwemererwa kwica umuntu”,

32.text: ngo ijambo rya Yesu risohore, iryo yavuze rimenyesha urupfu agiye gupfa.

33.text: Pilato yongera kwinjira mu rukiko, ahamagara Yesu aramubaza ati “Wowe uri umwami w'Abayuda?”

34.text: Yesu na we aramubaza ati “Mbese ibyo ubibajije ku bwawe, cyangwa se ni abandi bakubwiye ibyanjye?”

35.text: Pilato aramusubiza ati “Uragira ngo ndi Umuyuda? Ab'ubwoko bwanyu n'abatambyi bakuru ni bo bakunzaniye. Wakoze iki?”

36.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Ubwami bwanjye si ubw'iyi si, iyaba ubwami bwanjye bwari ubw'iyi si, abagaragu banjye baba barwanye ngo ntahabwa Abayuda, ariko noneho ubwami bwanjye si ubw'ino.”

37.text: Pilato aramubaza ati “Noneho ga uri umwami?”Yesu aramusubiza ati “Wakabimenye ko ndi umwami. Iki ni cyo navukiye kandi ni cyo cyanzanye mu isi: ni ukugira ngo mpamye ukuri, uw'ukuri wese yumva ijwi ryanjye.”

38.text: Pilato aramubaza ati “Ukuri ni iki?”Amaze kubivuga atyo aherako arasohoka, ajya aho Abayuda bari bari arababwira ati “Jyewe nta cyaha mubonyeho.

39.text: Icyakora mufite umugenzo ko mbabohorera imbohe imwe mu minsi ya Pasika. Mbese murashaka ko mbabohorera umwami w'Abayuda?”

40.text: Ariko bongera gusakuza bati “Si we dushaka, ahubwo utubohorere Baraba.” Baraba uwo yari umwambuzi.
